entries.title: Leviticus 12:1
segments: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.title: Leviticus 12:2
segments: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a woman conceive seed, and bear a man-child, then she shall be unclean seven days; as in the days of the impurity of her sickness shall she be unclean.

entries.title: Leviticus 12:3
segments: And in the eighth day the flesh of his foreskin shall be circumcised.

entries.title: Leviticus 12:4
segments: And she shall continue in the blood of [her] purifying three and thirty days; she shall touch no hallowed thing, nor come into the sanctuary, until the days of her purifying be fulfilled.

entries.title: Leviticus 12:5
segments: But if she bear a maid-child, then she shall be unclean two weeks, as in her impurity; and she shall continue in the blood of [her] purifying threescore and six days.

entries.title: Leviticus 12:6
segments: And when the days of her purifying are fulfilled, for a son, or for a daughter, she shall bring a lamb a year old for a burnt-offering, and a young pigeon, or a turtle-dove, for a sin-offering, unto the door of the tent of meeting, unto the priest:

entries.title: Leviticus 12:7
segments: and he shall offer it before Jehovah, and make atonement for her; and she shall be cleansed from the fountain of her blood. This is the law for her that beareth, whether a male or a female.

entries.title: Leviticus 12:8
segments: And if her means suffice not for a lamb, then she shall take two turtle-doves, or two young pigeons; the one for a burnt-offering, and the other for a sin-offering: and the priest shall make atonement for her, and she shall be clean.
